parameters.query:
-- Odoo CRM stage change detect: compare crm.lead.stage_id (Odoo) against last-known stage in clients_master
SELECT
  cl.id AS odoo_lead_id,
  cl.name,
  cl.email_from AS email,
  cl.phone,
  cl.partner_name AS company,
  st.name AS current_stage,
  cm.status AS last_known_status
FROM crm_lead cl
JOIN crm_stage st ON st.id = cl.stage_id
LEFT JOIN clients_master cm ON cm.odoo_lead_id = cl.id
WHERE cm.odoo_lead_id IS NULL
   OR st.name != cm.status
ORDER BY cl.write_date DESC
LIMIT 25;

nodes.name: [1.5] Detect CRM Stage Changes
nodes.notes: crm_lead aur crm_stage Odoo ke actual Postgres tables hain (same DB). st.name Odoo me aapke pipeline stages ke exact naam se match hone chahiye: New, Qualified, Contacted, Nurtured, Booked, Proposal Sent, Won, Onboarded, Delivered, Renewal - Section 1 wale funnel status ke mutabiq CRM pipeline stages rename kar lena.

parameters.query:
-- Leads jo turant qualified/booked nahi hue (warm/cold score) aur abhi nurture drip me hain
SELECT *
FROM clients_master
WHERE status IN ('Qualified', 'Contacted', 'Nurtured')
  AND score IN ('warm', 'cold')
  AND COALESCE(nurture_step, 0) < 3
  AND (
    last_nurture_sent IS NULL
    OR last_nurture_sent < now() - (CASE COALESCE(nurture_step, 0)
                                       WHEN 0 THEN INTERVAL '3 days'
                                       WHEN 1 THEN INTERVAL '7 days'
                                       ELSE INTERVAL '14 days'
                                     END)
  )
LIMIT 50;

nodes.name: [2.2] Fetch Leads Due for Nurture
nodes.notes: 3-step drip: Step 0 -> 3 din baad, Step 1 -> 7 din baad, Step 2 -> 14 din baad. Setup section me ALTER TABLE se nurture_step/last_nurture_sent columns add karne honge (agar abhi tak nahi hain).

parameters.query:
UPDATE clients_master
SET nurture_step = COALESCE(nurture_step, 0) + 1,
    last_nurture_sent = now(),
    status = CASE WHEN COALESCE(nurture_step, 0) + 1 >= 3 THEN 'Nurture Complete' ELSE 'Nurtured' END,
    updated_at = now()
WHERE odoo_lead_id = {{$json.odoo_lead_id}};
